name: SkyNet Online Shipping for WooCommerce
author: skynetza

sections.description:
SkyNet Online Shipping connects your WooCommerce store directly to SkyNet Online, SkyNet’s ecommerce shipping platform. Customers see real, account-specific shipping rates at checkout, orders are booked automatically the moment payment succeeds, and waybill numbers and tracking updates sync straight back to WooCommerce – no manual courier admin required.

About SkyNet

SkyNet Online is the world’s largest independently owned courier network, with a footprint spanning more than 190 countries and a national network of 32 branches covering all of South Africa. That scale and reach, paired with deep e-commerce shipping experience, is why online retailers choose SkyNet to move their orders – locally and across borders.

Features

  • Live Road, Air, and Counter shipping rates at checkout, pulled from your SkyNet account.
  • Automatic booking creation with SkyPoint Online on order placement.
  • Waybill numbers and tracking status synced to the order automatically.
  • Generate and download shipping labels directly from WooCommerce order admin.
  • PUDO pick-up point selection at checkout, based on the customer’s delivery address.
  • Free-shipping rules by order value or per product.
  • Shipping Profiles and a Default Package ensure rates and bookings work even when product weight or dimensions are missing.
  • Supports WooCommerce shipping classes for multi-location fulfilment routing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin through the WordPress admin or install directly from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → SkyNet Online and enter your SkyNet Online account credentials.
  3. Choose which shipping modes (Road, Air, Counter) to display and configure any Shipping Profiles or a Default Package.
  4. Save — live rates will now appear at checkout.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SkyNet account to use this plugin?

Yes. Rates and bookings are tied to your authenticated SkyNet Online account.

What happens if a product is missing weight or dimensions?

The plugin falls back to a Shipping Profile or your account’s Default Package, so checkout is never blocked.

Can customers choose a pick-up point instead of home delivery?

Yes, nearby SkyNet PUDO counters are shown at checkout based on the delivery address entered.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Feature: Dedicated, full-width Suburb and Postal Code live search autocomplete dropdown at checkout with real-time rate recalculation.
  • Enhancement: Sleek dark-themed dropdown UI with fixed pin indicator and right-aligned postal code badges.
  • Fix: Dynamic PUDO address token deduplication to guarantee pinpoint South African map localization.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Fallback shipping rate now applies as a flat cart rate without quantity multiplication.
  • Fix: Consolidated parcel packaging per product line item with aggregate weight for accurate live courier quoting and waybill creation.

1.0.4

  • Feature: Direct Settings-based default dimension fallback for unassigned products without database profile auto-creation.
  • Enhancement: Decoupled custom Shipping Profiles from global WooCommerce shipping settings.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Guaranteed immediate database profile sync upon saving shipping zone modal or options regardless of API authentication status.
  • Fix: Improved multi-instance zone settings detection for automatic profile synchronization.

1.0.2

  • Feature: Added automatic Default Box shipping profile auto-seeding upon installation.
  • Feature: Added real-time two-way synchronization between WooCommerce shipping settings and database shipping profiles.
  • Fix: Added WooCommerce native unit normalization (kg & cm) to prevent misconfigured store measurement units from inflating shipping quotes.
  • Fix: Enhanced multi-tier fallback dimension engine for unassigned products.
  • Fix: Cleaned up PHPCS comment strings in shipping profile management and report views.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Modernized checkout shipping cards UI with responsive layout adapter for compact order review tables.
  • Fix: Prevented duplicate native radio buttons from rendering inside custom shipping cards.
  • Fix: Full-width PUDO counter selection button inside checkout card with smooth hover transitions.
  • Fix: Prevented tax breakdown numbers from leaking into shipping rate titles.
  • Fix: Enhanced PUDO address geocoding query to ensure South African map localization.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
